Tue 22:00 conversation at Okafor house living room with Chidi Okafor [ref 21:05]:
Ngozi Okafor: "Right, I reckon he's had long enough with those teeth. Shall we go up?" (Mutes the telly and gets up off the sofa.)
Chidi Okafor: "Yeah, go on. I'm right behind you." (Puts down what he was doing and gets up.)
Ngozi Okafor: "After you then. Mind the third stair, it creaks and he'll know we're coming!" (Heads for the stairs, leaving the telly muted.)
Chidi Okafor: "Ha, right, thanks. Quietly now." (Follows her to the stairs, stepping over the third stair.)
Ngozi Okafor (Climbs the stairs, stepping over the creaky third one, and heads quietly to Emeka's room.)
Chidi Okafor: "Door's open a crack. Looks like he's still awake." (Reaches the landing and stops just behind Ngozi, keeping his voice low.)
Ngozi Okafor: "Shh, let's just peek. Emeka, love, you still awake? Dad's here too, we've come to say night." (Pushes the door open gently and whispers.)
Chidi Okafor: "Night, champ. Sleep well. Big day tomorrow." (Peers in softly over Ngozi's shoulder, voice low.)
Ngozi Okafor: "Night night, love. Love you. Lights out now, yeah? Don't be reading under the covers." (Stays in the doorway, whispering, smiling at Emeka.)
Chidi Okafor: "Night, son. Sleep tight." (Gives a small wave from behind Ngozi, then steps back from the doorway.)
Ngozi Okafor: "He's nearly gone, look at him. Come on, let's leave him be." (Pulls the door to, leaving it open a crack, and heads back toward the stairs quietly.)
Chidi Okafor: "Yeah, he's out for the count. Cuppa?" (Follows her quietly back toward the stairs, stepping over the third stair again.)
Ngozi Okafor: "Go on then, quick one. Just a peppermint for me, I'll never sleep otherwise." (Heads quietly down the stairs, stepping over the third one.)
Chidi Okafor: "Peppermint, got it. Kettle's quick, I'll bring it through." (Heads down the stairs behind her, stepping over the third one, then off toward the kitchen.)
Ngozi Okafor: "Lovely. I'll go and unmute the telly." (Heads down the stairs and back to the sofa, unmutes the telly.)
Chidi Okafor: "Kettle's on. Won't be a minute." (Fills the kettle and gets two mugs out, dropping a peppermint teabag in one.)
Ngozi Okafor (Settles back on the sofa and waits for the tea, glancing at the telly.)
Chidi Okafor: "Here we go, one peppermint. Want a biscuit with it?" (Carries two mugs through from the kitchen and hands Ngozi the peppermint tea.)
Ngozi Okafor: "Ooh, no biscuit, thanks, I've had plenty today. Cheers love. Come and sit, you've been staring at that laptop all night. Is that work thing still bugging you?" (Takes the mug and shifts up the sofa to make room.)
Chidi Okafor: "Bit of it, yeah. Deadline's just getting closer. Nothing I can't sort. Let's not talk shop, though. What are we watching?" (Sits down next to her on the sofa with his mug and closes the laptop lid on the coffee table.)
Ngozi Okafor: "Fair enough, no shop talk. I think there's that detective thing on next, or we could just see what's on. Is it any good, do you know?" (Sips the peppermint tea and leans back against him, eyes on the telly.)
Chidi Okafor: "No idea, to be honest. Let's give it ten minutes and see." (Puts an arm round her and glances at the telly.)
Ngozi Okafor: "Mm, go on then, ten minutes. If it's rubbish we'll find something else." (Snuggles into him with her tea, eyes on the telly.)
Chidi Okafor: "Mm. Looks a bit slow so far, but give it a go." (Sips his tea and keeps his arm round her, eyes on the telly.)
Ngozi Okafor: "Mm, it is a bit slow. Give it a few more minutes though." (Stays snuggled against him with her tea, eyes on the telly.)
Chidi Okafor: "Yeah, it's not grabbing me. Another five minutes, then we switch?" (Sips his tea, eyes on the telly.)
Ngozi Okafor: "Yeah, go on, five minutes and then we switch. Honestly I'd be happy with anything that isn't mumbling in a car park." (Sips her tea, stays leaning against him.)
Chidi Okafor: "Yeah, that's the five. Shall I flick through and see what else is on?" (Picks up the remote, keeps his other arm round her.)
Ngozi Okafor: "Go on then, have a flick. Nothing with cars in car parks!" (Sips her tea, stays leaning against him.)
Chidi Okafor: "Right, let's see. There's a quiz thing, or a documentary about bridges. Bridges?" (Flicks through channels with the remote, arm still round her.)
